resources.string: AQ Sync talks to your CoreS3 air-quality logger over Bluetooth Low Energy and copies its Parquet files onto this phone. It asks for Bluetooth scanning and connecting only. It never asks for location, and the app has no internet permission at all: nothing leaves this phone unless you share it.
Bluetooth permission was denied. Enable it in system settings to find your logger.
Turn Bluetooth on to find your logger.
Bring the phone near the CoreS3. It advertises as AQ-xxxx.
On first connection, type the 6-digit code shown on the device screen.
